capabilities: Generate images from the text under a configurable heading using an OpenAI-compatible API
Replace a defined placeholder image embed with the generated image
Regenerate the last generated image behind a Yes/No confirmation, optionally trashing the old file
Match the placeholder's embed dimensions when embedding the new image
Update the Image key in frontmatter for TTRPG vault compatibility
extras: Manual installation only (copy main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder); the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Smart Sizing may conflict with plugins like dnd-ui-toolkit that parse the | symbol in image links. AI Horde and local Stable Diffusion (AUTOMATIC1111) support are planned but not implemented.
motivation: The author originally built it for TTRPG Game Masters to create images for characters and locations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate images for notes from their description text or to swap generated art into existing image embeds.

relations.evidence: By default, it is configured to use OpenAI (DALL-E 3).

summary: AI image generator that reads text under a chosen heading in a note and replaces a placeholder image with art from an OpenAI-compatible API.
